fields.heading: What a *flow audit* looks at
fields.body:
In 15 minutes we trace one order from enquiry to delivery, with you or your department heads.

We mark each handoff where work waits or gets repeated. You get a one-page summary, yours whether you work with us or not.

items.title: Answering enquiries
items.before: New leads wait hours for someone to call back.
items.after: An AI assistant replies on WhatsApp in minutes and books the call.

items.title: Monthly reports

items.after: The report builds itself from your sheets and arrives by email.

items.title: Finding the right document

items.question: What happens in the free flow audit?
items.answer: A 15-minute call where we trace one process with you, mark where work waits or repeats, and send a one-page summary you keep.

items.question: Do you only work with GoHighLevel?
items.answer: No. We use GoHighLevel when it fits, and we also build with n8n, custom websites and AI models connected to the tools you already use.

items.question: Who owns what you build?
items.answer: You do. Everything we build belongs to you and keeps running after the project ends.

items.question: Can you work with our ERP or Tally?
items.answer: Yes. We can add an AI layer around systems like ERPNext, Tally or SAP: questions in plain words, automated MIS and alerts.

items.question: Do you look after systems after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We monitor workflows and agents, fix what breaks, and add new workflows when you need them.
